title: Founded Pop Mart in 2010 and built its collectible blind-box toy
statement: Founded Pop Mart in 2010 and built its collectible blind-box toy business, including the Labubu and Skullpanda product lines.
outcome: Pop Mart's Labubu-driven growth made Wang China's 10th richest individual by June 2025, with a Forbes-estimated net worth of $19.6 billion as of February 2026.

title: Signaled a strategic pivot toward balanced
statement: Signaled a strategic pivot toward balanced, sustainable growth and category diversification (including home appliances) following the March 2026 share-price drop.
outcome: As of the March 25, 2026 report, the market reaction (a sharp share drop) had occurred, but the ultimate success of the balanced-growth and diversification strategy was not yet determinable from the source.
